Liquid Glass: on

Your Telegram theme, power settings, media playback and account settings stay unchanged.

Liquid Glass: off
Reduce animations: off

Covered glass panels become solid and stop their blur rendering. Your Telegram theme and power settings stay unchanged.

Liquid Glass: off
Reduce animations: on

Covered glass panels become solid. Telegram-controlled animated emoji, stickers, chat backgrounds, particles and call effects are reduced. Media playback and navigation transitions keep their own settings.
Liquid Glass

On allows Telegram’s built-in glass effects, subject to your device and power saving settings. Off uses solid surfaces for the new glass panels and disables their blur rendering. Some older effects are not yet covered.

This Android version does not support Telegram’s glass refraction shader (Android 13 required). On allows supported native blur; off makes the new glass panels solid. Some older effects are not yet covered.
Reduce animations
Reduces animated emoji, stickers, chat backgrounds, particles and call effects controlled by Telegram’s power settings. Navigation transitions and media playback keep their separate settings.

Native refraction is currently disabled by Telegram’s effect or power settings. On allows available native blur; off makes the new glass panels solid and stops their blur rendering. Some older effects are not yet covered.
MOROK is an unofficial client using the Telegram API. Based on Telegram for Android; upstream copyright notices and GPL licensing are preserved. Source code: github.com/haewho/morok.
Experimental privacy
Ghost and activity controls
Account-local controls that already have semantic protocol hooks. Disabled by default.
Experimental feature. Telegram’s API rules conflict with suppressing online, read and typing activity. Sending messages, calls and another active session can still reveal presence.
Outgoing chat activity
Ghost preset
The current preset enables the implemented typing, ordinary online-status, message-read, voice/video content-read and story-view policies.
Hide typing and recording

Suppresses typing, recording, upload, sticker selection and emoji interaction activity from MOROK’s normal chat paths. Cancellation remains allowed; call signaling and server-required bot draft cleanup are unchanged.
Reset experimental privacy
Do not announce online
Prevents MOROK’s normal foreground lifecycle from sending online status and sends the usual offline status once. Messages, calls, server behavior and other sessions can still reveal presence.
Disable the Ghost preset, all individual controls and chat exceptions, restoring normal Telegram activity for this account?
Sign in to configure privacy for a stable Telegram account. Device appearance and connection settings remain available before login.
Effective state: supported outgoing chat activity is suppressed.
Effective state: normal Telegram typing activity.
Effective state: MOROK’s ordinary online announcement is suppressed.
Effective state: normal Telegram foreground online status.
Hide voice and video plays

Keeps the played state locally, but does not send the separate content-read receipt when MOROK plays an incoming voice or round video message in a normal chat. Secret and self-destructing media keep Telegram behavior.
Effective state: supported voice/video content-read receipts are suppressed.
Effective state: normal Telegram voice/video content-read receipts.
Read messages locally

Clears messages, badges and notifications locally without sending Telegram’s normal chat read cursor. Secret chats remain unchanged. The explicit “Mark as read” action in the chat list still sends the cursor to Telegram.
Effective state: ordinary server read receipts are suppressed.
Effective state: normal Telegram server read receipts.
Hide story views

Keeps viewed state on this device without sending the normal story read/view request. Reactions, replies and other explicit server actions can still reveal the view. Other sessions remain independent.
Effective state: supported story view receipts are suppressed.
Effective state: normal Telegram story view receipts.
Mark read after replying
When local-read mode is active, a successfully sent immediate reply synchronizes the replied incoming message with Telegram. Failed, edited, scheduled and secret-chat messages do not trigger it.
Delay sends by one minute in Ghost mode

Opt-in. While the Ghost preset is active, supported messages use Telegram’s server schedule. The scheduled queue opens in a chat and allows cancellation. This may reduce immediate presence disclosure, but does not guarantee invisibility. Unsupported sends are stopped with an explanation.
Queued by MOROK for one minute. You can cancel it in Scheduled Messages.
This message cannot use MOROK’s delayed Ghost send. It was not sent.
Normal-behavior exceptions
No exceptions. Add one from a message’s context menu in the required chat.
An exception restores normal typing, message/content-read and story-view behavior for that chat; online-status remains account-wide. Tap an exception to remove it.

Round video quality
Camera and round videos
Experimental local capture and encoding profiles. Disabled preserves Telegram’s current behavior.
Experimental and disabled by default. Actual quality depends on the camera, AVC encoder and Telegram compatibility. Receiver-side quality has not yet been confirmed.
Enhanced round video quality
Applies to the next recording. Uses the existing one-pass GPU and H.264 path, validates the source frame and encoder, and falls back before recording if the requested profile is unavailable.
Quality
Auto
Data saver
High
Auto targets up to 640×640 at 2.5 Mbit/s. Data saver keeps the compatible baseline. High tests up to 720×720 at 4 Mbit/s. A larger number is not proof of better receiver-side quality.

On Camera2, enhanced mode requests the narrowest supported FPS range containing 30, continuous-video autofocus and electronic stabilization. Unsupported controls remain at the camera template defaults.
